text:
maya: Quick flag — API ref mismatch for PATCH /models/{model_id}/settings. OpenAPI shows nested `safety.blocklist` but the example uses top-level `safety_blocklist`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 includes the outdated example.

jonathan: Which is canonical, the schema or the example?

lee: Runtime moved to nested SafetySettings (safety.blocklist) in Q3. We left a compatibility shim accepting flat keys, but docs should reflect the live contract (nested).

sam: Action: (1) update API example JSON, (2) update SDK snippets (Go/JS) in docs, (3) add short migration note + jq/curl transform.

maya: I can update the example + migration note and run the docs build locally — CI is failing with the linter.

doc-builder-bot: build failed: docs/api/models.yaml: schema-example-mismatch (error 1004). CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1234

jonathan: Go snippet in docs currently: `SafetyBlocklist: []string{"bad"}` — change to `Safety: &SafetySettings{ Blocklist: []string{"bad"} }`. I will open a follow-up PR to update code snippets.

lee: JS snippet needs `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. Audit curl examples too.

sam: Draft migration blurb: "Deprecated: top-level `safety_blocklist`. As of 2024-09-01, send `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. Compatibility shim for ~30 days." Include jq/curl transform.

maya: Proposed transform: `cat old.json | jq '{safety: {blocklist: .safety_blocklist}}' | curl -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/$ID/settings`

doc-builder-bot: once examples + schema align, linter should pass. Also update openapi/examples/models/update-settings.json if present.

jonathan: Owners: @maya update API example + migration note, @jonathan update docs snippets, @lee confirm shim removal date for migration text, @sam add changelog entry. I'll add docs-review label.

maya: Pushing my PR today and will link it here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
